title: Spaces of UCP maps and subalgebras of von Neumann algebras
summary: In this paper, we establish that several natural topologies on the space of state-preserving unital completely positive maps coincide and that make it a Polish space. We then focus on the subspace of state-preserving conditional expectations and analyse its topology in detail, recovering the Haagerup-Winslow result that it aligns with the Effros-Maréchal topology on the space of von Neumann subalgebras.
